text.content: Re-Braiding Cybernetics & AI Project

The Re-Braiding Cybernetics & Artificial Intelligence Project was launched on March 25, 2026, an online conversation titled “The Split”, using the moment when a group researchers decided to coin a new term—”Artificial Intelligence”—as a means of declaring separation from their grounding in Cybernetics.

text.content: 2025 #NewMacy Cybernetics Prize Winners Announced

text.content: Africa Mineral Pulse: Designing Agency in Africa's Extractive Economies

rich_text.plain_text: Africa Mineral Pulse: Designing Agency in Africa's Extractive Economies

text.content: [Fas Lebbie]

rich_text.plain_text: [Fas Lebbie]

text.content: This research builds upon doctoral work in Transition Design to explore how mineral transitions in Africa can increase data access and enhance choices for sustainable mineral futures. The pulse model proposes three categories: de-risking investment for sustainable mining practices, developing local benefaction infrastructure, and redistributing mineral wealth to local communities.

text.content: IntraNote: Prototyping an AI-Driven Design Rationale System Supporting Participatory Conversations

rich_text.plain_text: IntraNote: Prototyping an AI-Driven Design Rationale System Supporting Participatory Conversations

text.content: [Franklin Xu, Yixi (Chris) Wu, Yuhan (Max) Wu, Minghao Xu]

rich_text.plain_text: [Franklin Xu, Yixi (Chris) Wu, Yuhan (Max) Wu, Minghao Xu]

text.content: IntraNote is an AI-assisted Design Rationale System that supports participatory design in complex, multi-stakeholder settings. By making the structure of conversation visible, the system helps participants reflect, identify shared values, and engage with the perspectives of others.
